text:
Ravi P.: FYI SI-Forge flipped owner on acct_9002 and acct_9009 via the marketplace "co-sell" toggle. acct_9009 has an upcoming press window next week. We need a quick guardrail.

Elena G.: Which accounts exactly and do we have demos/PR at risk?

Ravi P.: acct_9002 (POC), acct_9009 (press 2026-06-01). Ken, can you confirm why the toggle caused an immediate SF ownership change?

Ken (SI-Forge): Sorry, we thought the marketplace "co-sell" toggle meant mutual consent and expected a webhook to partnerships. The UI hit the owner change directly 10. We can pause outreach and revert if needed.

Elena G.: Operational fix proposal: any marketplace-originated co-sell must create a pending_partnerships_review tag, set co_sell_role (SI_lead/Redwood_lead/Joint), and start a 48h announce_hold for press windows. If unconfirmed, revert owner.

Ravi P.: Agreed. Also add a short field "co_sell_window" (ISO date range) so Marketing can see planned announce windows.

Ken (SI-Forge): We'll update our intake flow to include co_sell_role and co_sell_window. We'll also stop any outward comms until partnerships confirms.

crm-bot: Note added to acct_9009: "Marketplace co-sell claim detected. Pending partnerships review. 48h hold on announcements." :white_check_mark:

Elena G.: I'll draft a 1-paragraph guidance for SIs: do not flip SF owner without marketplace intake + partnerships ack; include escalation contacts. Ravi, can you push the CRM rule to staging?

Ravi P.: On it. Draft YAML for staging: trigger: marketplace_co_sell -> actions: add_tag: pending_partnerships_review; set_field: co_sell_role; notify: [partnerships, owner]; hold_announcements: 48h; revert_if_unconfirmed: 48h. I'll stage today and roll after Elena posts the guidance.

Ken (SI-Forge): Thanks. We'll also add a quick tooltip in our onboarding saying "checking this box does not instantly change owner."

Elena G.: Perfect. Closing once staging is up and SI onboarding note is live.
